description: Scripts that prepare the inputs used by the figure notebooks. Input and generated data remain outside Git.

Rebuild same-assay reference sets, corrected UKBB protein identities, gene filters and current COMB novelty.

steps.description: Build reconciled circos lead points, capped radial scores, selected labels, axes and connector coordinates.

verification.final_vector_label_gaps: Display-only archived composition; not rerun in data preparation.

Aggregate each raw credible set once, preserve its source size, compute maximum PIP and tie count, and prepare main D/E plus S11 inputs.
Prepare exact S12 size summaries and gene-cluster analytic contrasts plus S13 bounded PIP density grids and summaries.
Recompute the historical S4 BH discovery proportions within each raw permutation-result file; count the shared reference-cohort samples.

steps.description: Read supplied pre-QC aggregate availability counts and recount post-QC RNA/proteome samples from the actual list and headers.

verification.limitation: The upstream participant availability export for the pre-QC aggregate source is not available; those supplied aggregate counts are preserved.

steps.description: Prepare current frequency bins, unique-variant ancestry tests, consequence-priority aFC data and regressions, cumulative aFC summaries, outlier statistics from contingency counts, protein-coding medians, and S16 ancestry bins.
steps.verification: Synthetic RED-to-GREEN checks passed. Full source-result preparation ran locally. Current frequency-bin counts and caches B-F/S16 matched the saved source data; A row order was then aligned with the original assay order. E OR/CI/Fisher statistics reproduce the source. F starts at upstream aggregate quantile results, not participant rows. No raw association model was rerun.

steps.description: Read FastENLOC result tables, assign per-pair Bayesian FDR calls, join validated variant/gene annotations and strongest posterior representatives, build credible-set components, fit current concordance and MAF-rate models, and derive S20-S23 summaries.
steps.verification: Full local preparation passed. All eight scientific caches match the current original caches within 1e-10: SuSiE, gene/CS/variant FastENLOC levels, components, model inputs, Wilson rates, and MAF regression. Synthetic RED-to-GREEN tests cover FDR ties, AF folding/missingness, annotation cutpoints, Wilson limits, count pooling, and MAF scaling. Preserved signed-log1p models emit their original NaN warnings; no new model was substituted.

steps.description: Reconstruct the symmetric two-layer credible-set background, clean coding annotations with canonical target-gene CDS/SpliceAI/cCRE criteria, collapse duplicate variants with geometric-mean PIP weights, and fit current MAF annotation models.
steps.verification: Full local source-result preparation passed. Symmetric universe and all 23 annotation-model fits match the original caches within 1e-10. Canonical GTF selection is equivalent with a direct compressed-file reader. The source reports unrecoverable partner credible sets in the other assay pairs; current E uses recoverable eQTL-pQTL only. No sequence model or FastENLOC job was run.

steps.description: Count distinct colocalizing genes by trait/category, join lenient union colocalization rates, then apply the current count/category/top-10 filters.
steps.verification: SOURCE-ONLY GAP: the complete harmonized gene result with trait_category and any_coloc is missing locally. The similarly named three-trait export is not a substitute. Pure distinct-count/rate-join tests pass; no saved summary was substituted for the required result input.

steps.description: Prepare heritability-normalized rare-variant R2 contrasts; remove conditional-TWAS artifacts; match control gene-trait pairs; derive QQ coordinates; join ClinGen/DGIdb sets; apply per-TWAS-path BH adjustment; collapse to genes and fit enrichment models.
steps.verification: Full local B-D preparation passed. All plotted data for B, C, and D match the current saved objects within 1e-10, including matched QQ coordinates and profiled enrichment intervals. Synthetic R2/QQ/zero-P checks pass. Source result tables, not raw association or conditional-TWAS models, are the upstream boundary.
